sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can name the main parts of the body and say what hurts.
I can describe how I feel and name basic symptoms.
I can ask and answer what's wrong, including how long it's lasted.
I can describe symptoms to a doctor and understand basic instructions.
I can ask for something for an ailment at the pharmacy.
